svg.title: Call360 architecture
svg.desc: Source data (call data, membership, medical and Rx claims, regulatory, surveys and member events) flows through Cloud Composer pipelines into BigQuery, then into per-domain Bigtable tables keyed by member ID and date with a 90-day TTL. The Call360 API selects few-shot examples with Sentence-BERT, summarizes with Gemini 2.5 Flash-Lite on Vertex AI, formats JSON in a second Gemini pass, and sends talking points to the agent desktop.
